# obs.price_bar r1

obs.price_bar r1: one daily bar of one instrument under one basis; a restated day is a new adjust_epoch row, an existing row is never changed.

| column | type | nullable | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| instrument_id | integer | no | Instrument the bar belongs to. |
| basis | enum(trades, adjusted_last) | no | trades: traded prices as printed; adjusted_last: last prices adjusted for splits and dividends. |
| adjust_epoch | integer | no | Epoch of the pull, from 1; a restated day is written again under the next epoch, and readers take the highest epoch of an instrument and basis. |
| session_day | string (date) | no | Session day the bar covers. |
| open | string | no | Opening price as decimal text. |
| high | string | no | Highest price as decimal text. |
| low | string | no | Lowest price as decimal text. |
| close | string | no | Closing price as decimal text. |
| volume | string | yes | Volume as decimal text; null when the source gives none (adjusted_last rows). The key is always present. |
| currency | string | no | Currency code of the prices, for example USD. |
| source | enum(ibkr) | no | Where the row came from. |
| received_at | string (date-time) | no | Instant the row was received, UTC. |

Primary key: (instrument_id, basis, adjust_epoch, session_day)
